 Print Raha, the daughter of Ranbir Kapoor and Alia Bhatt, turned 4 on November 6, and the Kapoor and Bhatt families seem to have celebrated together. Alia and Ranbir have kept the party mostly private, but grandmother Neetu Kapoor shared a single photo from the gathering. Her post was simple and revealed little about the festivities, so fans are still hoping for more glimpses of Raha’s big day. Neetu Kapoor shares a glimpse of Raha Kapoor’s birthday card
 Neetu offered a sweet glimpse into Raha’s birthday via her Instagram Stories. Though the family has kept the celebrations mostly private, the veteran actress posted a picture showing a small hand with painted nails, apparently Raha’s, placed on a colourful card reading “Raha’s Party.” The card, set in a fun, playful font, was illustrated with a school van decked out in balloons, a party banner, and a bottle of nail polish, giving the décor a lively, festive feel. Alia Bhatt pens a note for Ranbir Kapoor and Raha Kapoor
 Alia also shared sweet pictures of Ranbir and Raha from the sets of ' Ramayana '. With the epic now playing in theatres, the actress wrote a heartfelt note applauding her husband’s powerful turn as Lord Rama. She wrote, “You poured everything into this one and somehow still had all of it left for her. so proud of you Ranbir and of every single person who brought their heart and soul to this incredible experience at the movies. some stories are bigger than all of us & Ramayana is one of them.” Raha Kapoor has been part of the ‘Ramayana’ journey
 In a recent BBC interview, Ranbir shared that Raha has dropped by the sets of Ramayana several times and has been part of the film’s journey. He also revealed that his daughter even filmed a shot with Sai Pallavi and Ravie Dubey. The actor said, “Raha herself is so interested in the story of the Ramayana. Me and Alia (Bhatt), we always tell her stories. She has visited the sets many times. She has given a shot with Sai and Lakshman (Ravie Dubey) also. So she’s really been a part of this journey. I am so happy that this would be the first story that she will watch on screen because I would like her to watch it.” Ranbir Kapoor’s ‘Ramayana’ cast and what’s next
 In 'Ramayana', Ranbir plays Lord Rama, with Sai Pallavi as Sita, Ravie Dubey as Lakshman, and Yash as Ravana. A post-credits scene introduces Sunny Deol as Hanuman, a character who will return in Ramayana Part 2. The sequel is scheduled to release in 2028.
